backbone._note: LAION-CLAP (Wu et al., ICASSP 2023). 630k-audioset-best is the README's pick for general audio under 10 s (non-fusion, HTSAT-tiny). Input: 16 kHz -> 48 kHz, repeat + zero-pad to 10 s (paper 3.4). Head = pretrained projection MLP + class layer initialised from the text embeddings of the prompt (paper Fig. 1 supervised path, 4.3 zero-shot prompt; zero-shot head as fine-tuning init per WiSE-FT, Wortsman et al., CVPR 2022). HTSAT's own stochastic depth (drop_path 0.1) is kept; no dropout override. Zero-shot before training, 360 test clips: 0.553 clean noise, 0.297 mixture.

teacher._recipe_note: Same recipe as train_config_high_beats_bandtrain.json (BEATs paper, AS-20K column) so the comparison isolates the backbone. trainable_blocks=12 is all of HTSAT's Swin blocks (2+2+6+2); patch merging and the final norm train with the block below them.

attention._note: Soft attention mask A(t,f) over the patch tokens (direction 2, run7_attn). hidden=128 matches FiLM and the CRD projection; lr matches film_lr, the rate every other new module here uses. Neither value comes from a paper for this task.

student._recipe_note: Same recipe as train_config_high_beats_bandtrain.json (BEATs paper, AS-20K column) so the comparison isolates the backbone. trainable_blocks=12 is all of HTSAT's Swin blocks (2+2+6+2); patch merging and the final norm train with the block below them.

augment._note: No roll for the student: patch-level CRD pairs student patch i with teacher patch i, and a time shift on the mixture only would misalign them. SpecAugment acts on CLAP's log-mel after bn0.

loss._note: crd_level 'patch' aligns every patch token against the teacher's; 'pooled' reproduces the BEATs project's single-vector CRD. With CLAP the patches are the tokens of the 25 time steps (of 32) that lie on signal, x 2 frequency halves = 50 per clip; the zero-pad steps are dropped. Weights r/a/b come from the CRD reference repo (-r 1 -a 1 -b 0.8); do not invent replacements.

gates._teacher_gate_note: Gate = baseline_band_accuracy + 0.10 = 0.6315. The mid project's absolute 0.75 floor sat above a 0.67 mixture baseline; carried to this band (baseline 0.53) it stopped a clean-noise teacher of 0.738, which is 0.21 above the baseline - twice the mid project's teacher headroom (0.78 - 0.67 = 0.11). Flagged as uncalibrated for SSLAM/high from the first commit; recalibrated after the teacher sweep of 2026-09-28.
gates._baseline_band_note: Published BEATs-Mixture, Result.xlsx 'Theo tung SNR': (0.5769@15dB + 0.4861@20dB)/2 and (0.5757+0.4830)/2, equal support (1080 each). This is the gate; it is NOT the same run as BEATs_Experts/checkpoint/test_metrics_36.json (that checkpoint's own 15/20 numbers are 0.6102/0.5315 - a different training run, no per-clip predictions, cannot enter a paired test).

published_baseline.name: BEATs-Mixture (Result.xlsx)
published_baseline._note: Copied from Result.xlsx, sheet 'Theo tung SNR', rows BEATs-Mixture / final, all six levels (the band-only report keeps 15 and 20; --full-test uses all). Only accuracy and F1 exist there, and no per-clip predictions, so it cannot enter the McNemar comparison.

evaluation._note: Train, validation and test all use only the 15-20 dB rows (10,080 / 2,160 / 2,160), as in train_config_high_beats_bandtrain.json, so the BEATs and CLAP runs pair clip for clip in report_36.py's compare mode.
